evidence.note: Entry-side coat closet door is fully closed.
User grips the closet-door handle and begins pulling.
Door is open, exposing coats and shoes.
User grips the open door to close it.
Closet door is fully closed again.

events.object_description: Entry-side coat closet door; open is treated as on and closed as off.

evidence.note: Microwave door is closed.
User reaches for the microwave handle.
Microwave door has swung open.
Microwave remains open.
User pushes the door toward the appliance.
Microwave door is closed.

events.object_description: Microwave door; open is on and closed is off.

evidence.note: Oven door is closed.
User pulls the oven handle and the door starts lowering.
Oven door is open and the illuminated interior is visible.
Oven remains open.
User lifts the oven door closed.
Oven door is fully closed.

events.object_description: Range oven door; open is on and closed is off.

evidence.note: Dishwasher door is closed as the user reaches toward it.
Dishwasher door is lowered open, exposing the racks.
Dishwasher remains open.
User lifts the dishwasher door.
Dishwasher is fully closed.

events.object_description: Dishwasher door; open is on and closed is off.

evidence.note: Both leaves of the upper cabinet above the sink are closed.
User reaches to the cabinet's lower edge.
A projecting cabinet leaf and exposed shelves show that opening is underway or complete.
The left cabinet leaf is visibly open beside the exposed shelves.
Both cabinet leaves remain open.
Cabinet front is closed again while the user's hand withdraws.

events.object_description: Left leaf of the double-door upper cabinet above the sink; open is on and closed is off.

evidence.note: Both leaves of the upper cabinet above the sink are closed.
User initiates manipulation at the cabinet front.
The right cabinet leaf is visibly swung open beside exposed shelves.
Right cabinet leaf remains open.
Both leaves are closed again.

events.object_description: Right leaf of the double-door upper cabinet above the sink; open is on and closed is off.

evidence.note: Lower drawer beside the refrigerator is closed.
User grips the drawer front.
Drawer is pulled open, exposing stored boxes and bags.
Drawer remains open.
Drawer is fully closed.

events.object_description: Lower kitchen drawer immediately left of the refrigerator; open is on and closed is off.

evidence.note: Upper refrigerator door is closed.
User pulls the refrigerator handle.
Upper refrigerator compartment is open and illuminated.
Upper refrigerator door remains open.
User pushes the upper door closed.
Upper refrigerator door is fully closed.

events.object_description: Upper refrigerator door; open is on and closed is off.

evidence.note: Lower freezer door is closed.
User grips the lower handle and begins pulling.
Lower freezer door is open and the compartment is illuminated.
Freezer door remains open.
User pushes the freezer door closed.
Lower freezer door is fully closed.

events.object_description: Lower freezer door of the refrigerator; open is on and closed is off.

evidence.note: Laundry-closet room door is closed.
Door is open, revealing the stacked washer and dryer.
Laundry door remains open.
User pulls the door shut by its handle.
Laundry-closet door is fully closed.

events.object_description: Laundry-closet door beside the windows; open is on and closed is off.

notes: Open positions are interpreted as on states. The two independently movable leaves of the upper cabinet are reported separately as required, although their individual opening and closing order is only weakly resolved by the 8-frame sampling.
scene_description: A user traverses a studio apartment and consecutively manipulates a coat-closet door, microwave, oven, dishwasher, upper cabinet leaves, a lower drawer, refrigerator and freezer doors, and a laundry-closet door.
